transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I've been having a really hard time focusing and paying attention to tasks lately, and staying organized has been a real struggle too. I wanted to come in today to see if I could get some help with these issues.
Do you also experience feelings of restlessness, or have difficulty sitting still, or find yourself often fidgeting or feeling an urge to be constantly on the go?

Yes, I definitely do. I find myself constantly fidgeting, tapping my feet, or squirming in my chair when I'm supposed to be sitting still. I also have this persistent feeling of restlessness that makes it really hard to just relax.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity, and did they start when you were a child or did they develop later in life?
These current symptoms have been really prominent for about two years and five months now. However, they actually first started back when I was a kid, definitely before I turned 12.
Have these symptoms significantly impacted your daily life, relationships, or work/school performance, and if so, can you give me some specific examples?

Honestly, I haven't thought about it in detail, so I'm not quite sure how to describe the specific impact. I just know that I generally struggle a lot with staying organized and keeping my focus on my daily tasks.

Can you try to think of some specific situations or instances where you felt like your symptoms got in the way of what you were trying to do, such as at work, in school, or in your personal relationships?
I'm really not sure, and I can't recall any specific examples in my work, school, or relationships right now. It is just a general, constant struggle for me to keep up with things every day.

Would you say that your symptoms of inattention and hyperactivity are present and cause you significant distress or impairment in multiple settings, such as at home, in social situations, and in quiet activities?
I haven't really thought about how it affects me in those different settings, so I'm not really sure how to answer that. I just know it's a constant struggle for me overall.
Are there any situations or environments where you feel your symptoms are better managed or less problematic, or do you experience them consistently across all aspects of your life?
I haven't really thought about it, so I'm not sure if there are specific environments where they are better managed. For me, these struggles just seem to feel fairly constant no matter where I am.

Just to summarize, you've been experiencing symptoms of inattention, such as difficulty focusing and staying organized, along with symptoms of hyperactivity, like fidgeting and restlessness, for most of your life, starting before age 12, and these symptoms have been causing you significant distress and impairment. Is that a correct understanding of your experience?

Yes, that is a very accurate summary of my experience. My struggles with focusing, staying organized, fidgeting, and restlessness have indeed been going on for over two years now, and they definitely started before I turned 12.

Based on what you've shared, it sounds like your symptoms align with the criteria for Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder, Combined Presentation. Would you like to discuss treatment options and strategies to help manage your symptoms?
Yes, I would definitely be interested in hearing about the treatment options you recommend. I'm very open to learning about any strategies that could help me manage these symptoms better.
